condition: target.isEncrypted is False and target.crossesBoundary is True
description: Data crosses a trust boundary in clear text and can be sniffed or changed in transit
mitigation: Use TLS 1.2+ (prefer 1.3) on every flow that crosses a boundary
references: ASVS V12 Secure Communication (verify numbering); CAPEC-157

condition: target.carriesCredentials is True and target.isEncrypted is False
description: Credentials or tokens travel unencrypted and can be replayed
mitigation: Encrypt the channel and use short-lived, sender-constrained tokens

condition: target.receivesUntrustedInput is True and target.authenticatesSource is False
description: A process that receives untrusted input does not authenticate the caller
mitigation: Authenticate every request (session, OIDC or API token) before business logic

description: No object- or function-level authorization check
mitigation: Deny by default; check owner and role on every object and function

condition: target.receivesUntrustedInput is True and target.sanitizesInput is False
description: Untrusted input reaches the process without validation (injection risk)
mitigation: Validate input with an allowlist schema; use bind variables for SQL

condition: target.rendersHTML is True and target.encodesOutput is False
description: HTML output is not context-encoded (cross-site scripting)
mitigation: Use an auto-escaping template engine and a strict CSP

condition: target.receivesUntrustedInput is True and target.handlesResourceConsumption is False
description: No rate limits, size limits or timeouts on an exposed process
mitigation: Rate limit per client, cap body size, set timeouts

description: Security-relevant actions are not logged, so users can deny them
mitigation: Log who did what and when, to an append-only store; never log secrets

condition: target.storesPII is True and target.isEncrypted is False
description: Personal data is stored without encryption at rest
mitigation: Encrypt at rest (TDE or storage encryption) with managed keys

description: Datastore accepts connections without per-account grants
mitigation: Least-privilege database accounts; no shared admin login

description: No tested backup: data loss or ransomware stops the service
